Uvicorn is part of 1 of my public repositories, from 2026 to 2026.

What it was for: [Media and art](@/projects/media.md) (1).

Most recently: [openttd-prismatic-bridge](@/work/openttd-prismatic-bridge.md): REST/Swagger bridge onto OpenTTD's Admin Network, for prismatic-platform.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Uvicorn: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Uvicorn to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
